name: starlette-inbound-message-lineage
instr:
Give Starlette applications stable, inspectable lineage for every inbound HTTP and WebSocket message, including messages transformed by middleware or consumed during failures. Callers can trace derived messages and parsed artifacts back to immutable connection-local records without affecting normal protocol behavior.

Every validated server message receives exactly one immutable identity in receive order, and Request and WebSocket `receive_event` expose that event without duplicate allocation. `inbound_history` returns an insertion-ordered immutable snapshot that never changes after capture. One ledger follows a connection through application policy, routing, mounted scopes, authentication, endpoint execution, and handled exception dispatch, while concurrent connections remain isolated. Forwarded, consolidated, and synthetic messages retain ordered parent identities for exactly the server records that caused them, including cached replay, terminal messages, disconnects, and rejected size-limit chunks. Form fields expose their contributing identities through `lineage_for`, and UploadFile exposes them through `inbound_event_ids`, always referring to the same history visible to handlers and authentication backends. Authentication inspection consumes nothing, creates no events, and cannot affect subsequent HTTP or WebSocket reads. Successful WebSocket validation precedes recording, while parsing, limit, and disconnect failures preserve a completed immutable history for the config
